topic.title: Driving World Models and Interactive Motion Planning
topic.overview: Autonomous-driving models must represent roads, other agents, and the consequences of the vehicle's own actions. This topic combines imitation learning, trajectory prediction, generative world models, and closed-loop planning. A representative system learns a compact geometry-aware world model and policy from expert video, then predicts states and actions useful for driving.
topic.whyItMatters: Plausible individual trajectories do not ensure realistic interaction over a long rollout. Evaluation must consider consistency with observed history, other agents' responses, physical feasibility, and the time available to make decisions.
topic.evolution: Early representatives study adaptive navigation and collision avoidance. Later work learns urban-driving policies and video world models from offline data. Recent approaches use flow matching, token prediction, and streaming vector graphs to improve interactive motion generation and computational efficiency, alongside benchmarks for spatiotemporal understanding.
openQuestions: How well do simulator improvements predict performance under unfamiliar real-world interactions?
How can models preserve physical and behavioral consistency during extended closed-loop rollouts?

papers.title: STSBench: A Spatio-temporal Scenario Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models in Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: STSBench creates verified driving-scenario questions that expose weaknesses in vision-language models’ reasoning about traffic across views and time.

papers.title: T-norm Selection for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving with Logical Constraints
papers.tldr: MOD-ECL adaptively selects logical-loss formulations and their training influence to reduce constraint violations, with detection improvements in some cases.

papers.title: The Matrix: Infinite-Horizon World Generation with Real-Time Moving Control
papers.tldr: The Matrix combines game supervision and real-world footage to generate long, controllable 720p video streams with reported zero-shot transfer to new scenarios.

papers.title: TopoPoint: Enhance Topology Reasoning via Endpoint Detection in Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: TopoPoint explicitly detects and refines lane endpoints to improve intersection connectivity reasoning for autonomous driving.

papers.title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
papers.tldr: TrajICL adapts pedestrian trajectory prediction without weight updates by selecting scene-specific examples using spatial, temporal, and predicted-motion similarity.

papers.title: TraffiDent: A Dataset for Understanding the Interplay Between Traffic Dynamics and Incidents
papers.tldr: TraffiDent aligns traffic measurements, road attributes, and incident records to support joint forecasting, classification, and causal analysis.

papers.title: TrajMamba: An Efficient and Semantic-rich Vehicle Trajectory Pre-training Model
papers.tldr: TrajMamba combines GPS and road modeling, purpose-aware pretraining, and learned trajectory compression to improve accuracy and efficiency.

papers.title: TransferTraj: A Vehicle Trajectory Learning Model for Region and Task Transferability
papers.tldr: TransferTraj combines regional context modeling with a shared masking-and-recovery interface to transfer across trajectory tasks and regions.

papers.title: UniMotion: A Unified Motion Framework for Simulation, Prediction and Planning
papers.tldr: UniMotion shares a Transformer across driving simulation, prediction, and planning, with joint-training benefits and state-of-the-art results after task-specific fine-tuning.

papers.title: UniTraj: Learning a Universal Trajectory Foundation Model from Billion-Scale Worldwide Traces
papers.tldr: UniTraj combines worldwide GPS data, adaptable pretraining, and a flexible architecture to improve trajectory modeling across tasks and regions.

papers.title: UrbanIng-V2X: A Large-Scale Multi-Vehicle, Multi-Infrastructure Dataset Across Multiple Intersections for Cooperative Perception
papers.tldr: UrbanIng-V2X provides synchronized vehicle and roadside sensor data across three intersections for broader cooperative perception evaluation.

papers.title: V2X-Radar: A Multi-modal Dataset with 4D Radar for Cooperative Perception
papers.tldr: V2X-Radar provides real-world radar, LiDAR, and camera data with benchmarks for cooperative, roadside, and single-vehicle perception.

papers.title: VLMLight: Safety-Critical Traffic Signal Control via Vision-Language Meta-Control and Dual-Branch Reasoning Architecture
papers.tldr: VLMLight switches between fast traffic control and collaborative language-model reasoning to improve emergency response while preserving routine performance.

papers.title: WorldModelBench: Judging Video Generation Models As World Models
papers.tldr: WorldModelBench evaluates video generators for instruction following and physical consistency, using human labels and a specialized automated judge.

papers.title: Ask Less, See More: Communication-Conditioned Token Pruning for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Cooperative Autonomous Driving with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.tldr: V2V-CCM uses question intent and shared LiDAR coverage to reduce communication and inference costs in cooperative vehicle reasoning.

papers.title: Being More Lightweight and Practical: Mini-sized Contrastive Learning Pre-trained Models for Fine-grained Traffic Task
papers.tldr: MiniTraffic transfers road-level information into compact models for fine-grained traffic prediction using little target data.

papers.title: DeepSight: Long-Horizon World Modeling via Latent States Prediction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: DeepSight combines parallel prediction of future BEV features with adaptive text reasoning to improve closed-loop driving performance.

papers.title: DynVLA: Learning World Dynamics for Action Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: DynVLA predicts compact world-dynamics tokens before driving actions, improving decisions while preserving efficient inference.

papers.title: GeoFlow: Geo-Aware Modeling of Inter-Area Relationships in Origin-Destination Flow Prediction and Generation
papers.tldr: GeoFlow incorporates geographic structure into origin–destination modeling to improve flow prediction and the fidelity and diversity of generated mobility samples.

papers.title: Learning Global Representation from Queries for Vectorized HD Map Construction
papers.tldr: MapGR improves vectorized map construction by teaching object queries to learn and use global map context.

papers.title: MapUQ: Map with Uncertainty Quantification for Robust BEV Vectorized Construction
papers.tldr: MapUQ uses uncertainty-aware features, adaptive decoding, and negative samples to improve vectorized road maps and confidence estimates.

papers.title: Mobility-Embedded POIs: Learning What A Place Is and How It Is Used from Human Movement
papers.tldr: ME-POIs combines visit patterns with textual embeddings to represent both what places are and how people use them.

papers.title: NOMAD: Lifelong Trajectory Planning via Non-Parametric Bayesian Memory-Adaptive Diffusion Experts
papers.tldr: NOMAD combines expanding Bayesian memory, diffusion planning, and generative replay to learn rare driving scenarios while retaining earlier skills.

papers.title: OSM+: Billion-Level Open Street Map Dataset for City-wide Experiments
papers.tldr: OSM+ provides a queryable billion-vertex worldwide road graph and city-scale datasets for traffic prediction and policy-control research.

papers.title: RAST-MoE-RL: A Regime-Aware Spatio-Temporal MoE Framework for Deep Reinforcement Learning in Ride-Hailing
papers.tldr: RAST-MoE uses specialized experts to adapt ride-hailing matching decisions to changing conditions, reducing both matching and pickup delays in the reported evaluation.

papers.title: Reasoning-VLA: An Efficient and Spatial-Guided General Vision-Language-Action Reasoning Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: Reasoning-VLA uses spatially guided action queries and parallel decoding to improve autonomous-driving performance, generalization, and inference speed.

papers.title: RoCA: Robust Cross-Domain End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: RoCA uses probabilistic vehicle-token and trajectory modeling to improve cross-domain driving generalization and adaptation without extra inference computation for the trained base model.

papers.title: SKETCH: Semantic Key-Point Conditioning for Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory Prediction
papers.tldr: SKETCH conditions vessel trajectories on an inferred semantic next key point to improve long-horizon direction and motion prediction.

papers.title: SMD: Multi-view Safety-Critical Driving Video Generation in the Real-world Domain
papers.tldr: SMD generates risky multi-view driving videos that challenge planners during testing and improve robustness when used for training.

papers.title: TF-FACE: Time-Frequency Fusion Learning via Frequency-Domain Adaptive and Controllable Enhancement for Trajectory Prediction
papers.tldr: TF-FACE adaptively combines temporal and frequency features to improve multimodal traffic trajectory prediction with real-time inference.

papers.title: TimeSpot: Benchmarking Geo-Temporal Understanding in Vision–Language Models in Real-World Settings
papers.tldr: TimeSpot tests location, time, and physical-context inference from images, revealing especially weak temporal understanding in evaluated vision-language models.

papers.title: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs
papers.tldr: VectorWorld incrementally generates vector-graph driving scenes and physics-aligned traffic, enabling stable real-time rollouts beyond one kilometer.
